Actors Address On-Set Tension Rumors After 'Free Palestine' Remarks

Actors from the Netflix rom-com 'Nobody Wants This' have addressed rumors of on-set tension following remarks made by star Adam Brody about 'Free Palestine.' Actress Kristen Bell, who plays Brody's on-screen mother, stated that tensions are not rising and that "nobody wants this" situation. The reports of tension emerged after Brody's public statements.
